headline: HBL Partners with AKD Securities for Digital Pakistan Stock Exchange Accounts
summary: HBL became the first commercial bank in Pakistan to partner with AKD Securities to enable real-time Pakistan Stock Exchange trading account openings via mobile app without paperwork, supported by SECP and NCCPL.
why: Habib Bank Limited (HBL) is a major commercial bank in Pakistan, and digital onboarding initiatives expand retail participation in capital markets.

impacts.name: Habib Bank Limited
impacts.why: Digital integration expands retail brokerage accounts and banking transaction services.
